description: Implementation of OrderService handling order processing, total calculation, status history, invoice generation, and related functionalities in an e-commerce system.

classes.name: OrderServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for handling order-related operations such as processing orders, calculating totals, managing status history, and generating invoices.

methods.name: addOrderStatusHistory
methods.description: Adds a new status history record to an order and updates it.

methods.name: processOrder
methods.description: Processes a new order with customer, items, summary, payment, and optional transaction; handles payment processing, status updates, and persistence.

methods.name: caculateOrderTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total summary for an order, including sub-totals, taxes, shipping, handling, and grand total.

methods.name: caculateOrder
methods.description: Performs detailed calculation of order totals based on a summary, customer, store, and language.

methods.name: calculateShoppingCartTotal
methods.description: Calculates total prices for a shopping cart, updating item prices and order summaries.

methods.name: generateInvoice
methods.description: Generates a PDF invoice as a ByteArrayOutputStream for a given order.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves an order by its unique identifier.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all orders associated with a particular merchant store.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new order or updates an existing one based on its ID.

methods.name: hasDownloadFiles
methods.description: Checks if an order contains downloadable files in any of its products.
